findings.cause: uniforms is recreated inside doc.graph.stages.map, and u_grape_ + uniforms.size restarts from zero for each stage. GLSL program linkage merges same-name uniforms across vertex and fragment stages, so stage-local ordinal identity does not preserve distinct resources.
findings.expectedBehavior: Generated binding symbols must preserve resource identity across the complete linked shader program. Distinct resources cannot alias; one resource used across stages must keep coherent type/default/binding semantics. Generate correct shaders and schema or explicitly reject an unsupported combination before reporting success.
